# Tarot Gothique 2026

> French tarot card game for Android smartphones and tablets, with a gothic theme. Free to download and to play, with optional in-app purchases (chips and cosmetic items). Play online against other players in real time or solo against an AI, at 3, 4 or 5 players, following the rules of French tarot. Created and published by Cyril Darbost. The game and this site are available in 15 languages (fr, en, es, de, it, pt, ru, tr, ar, hi, bn, id, ja, ko, zh). The Android app is currently in closed beta on Google Play.

## Main pages (French)

- [Accueil – Jeu de Tarot Gothique 2026](https://tarot-gothique-2026.com/): presentation of the game, 3/4/5-player modes, FAQ
- [Règles du tarot à 3, 4 et 5 joueurs](https://tarot-gothique-2026.com/regles.html): deal, contracts, card values, Bouts, how to count points, petit au bout, poignées
- [L'IA de Tarot Gothique](https://tarot-gothique-2026.com/ia-tarot.html): how the computer opponents play
- [Divination par la Faucheuse](https://tarot-gothique-2026.com/divination-faucheuse.html): secret reward for the winner of an online game
- [Galerie](https://tarot-gothique-2026.com/galerie.html): screenshots of the app
- [À propos et FAQ](https://tarot-gothique-2026.com/apropos.html): creator, technology, contact
- [Devenir testeur bêta](https://tarot-gothique-2026.com/tarot_gothique_testeurs.html): how to join the closed beta
